description: This file defines the DebugProfiler class responsible for profiling and debugging within the Goteo project. It manages events, SQL queries, session, cookies, and rendering of debug information.

classes.name: DebugProfiler
classes.description: Class responsible for collecting, processing, and rendering profiling data such as events, SQL queries, session and cookie info for debugging purposes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the profiler by setting up view folder, stopwatch, and start time.

methods.name: addKernelEvent
methods.description: Adds a kernel event to the profiler, recording timing and controller/request/response info.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the profiling data view with collected stats, events, session, cookies, and headers.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Singleton pattern to get the current instance of DebugProfiler.

methods.name: addEvent
methods.description: Static method to add a kernel event.

methods.name: getHeadContent
methods.description: Returns the rendered header content for the debug view.

methods.name: getBodyContent
methods.description: Returns the rendered body content for the debug view.
